name: Barracuda Email Protection
summary: Barracuda sells Email Protection in tiered plans that combine gateway filtering, impersonation and business email compromise detection, and quarantine tools. Its pricing page shows a per-user field with no amount in the page text we could read, plus a Get Custom Quote button and a note that minimums apply.

facts.text: Barracuda's documentation lists six plans: three Integrated Email Protection tiers and Email Protection Advanced, Premium and Premium Plus. Email Gateway Defense is included only in the three Email Protection plans.
Admins can view and release emails that Microsoft quarantined from the Barracuda console.
Barracuda lists spam, malware and advanced threat protection as a use case, and describes remediating, releasing or quarantining across thousands of mailboxes.
Barracuda offers a free Email Threat Scan and a Try Free trial link, with no trial length stated.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page says minimums apply but does not state them.
